name: Wind and Small Hydro Energy Systems
description: Introduction, general theories of wind machines, basic laws and concepts of aerodynamics, micro-siting, wind data analysis, wind resource assessment, wind energy converters, description and performance of the horizontal–axis wind machines, blade design, description and performance of the vertical–axis wind machines. The generation of electricity by wind machines, operational challenges in wind machines, case studies, overview of micro, mini and small hydro, site selection and civil works, penstocks and turbines (Pelton, Francis, Kaplan, Hydrokinetic), design of Pelton and Francis turbine, operational challenges in hydro turbines that is, cavitation and sediment erosion, analysis of economic feasibility of a hydroelectric project, pumped-storage hydropower plants, reversible Francis turbine, variable speed turbine, wind and hydro based stand-alone / hybrid power systems, an overview of CFD analysis in hydro applications, case studies.
